description: This file defines the interface BusinessDateWritePlatformService in the org.apache.fineract infrastructure module. It declares methods for updating business date and increasing date by type, used for business date handling in the system.

classes.name: BusinessDateWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for business date write operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: updateBusinessDate
methods.description: Updates the business date with provided BusinessDateDTO.

methods.name: increaseDateByTypeByOneDay
methods.description: Increases the business date by one day based on the specified BusinessDateType, may throw JobExecutionException.
